messages:
maria-cs: Quick alert: onboarding delays for ~15 tenants provisioned during last night's EU index migration. Need customer comms, localized copies, and credit offer.

ashley-se: DM the tenant list and a one-line RCA we can paste. ETA to full restore?

maria-cs: DMing list. RCA: indexer backlog + aggressive provisioning retries hit a rate limiter during migration traffic.

sam-eng: Mitigations applied: added indexer workers, relaxed retry backoff, and widened limiter window temporarily. Queue depth falling; expect most tenants to be caught up in ~30-45m.

neil-ops: Limiter change deployed at 17:18 UTC, alerts cleared. Backfill progress: 9/15 complete, continuing.

lina-localization: I can return FR/DE/ES translations in ~20m once the final subject/body are posted.

maria-cs: Draft outbound (will localize):
Subject: Update: onboarding delay during EU migration \u2014 remediation and offer
Hi <Customer name>,
We experienced a provisioning delay for customers onboarded during a platform migration in the EU region. Our engineers implemented a fix; your tenant's index should be available shortly.
What we did: increased processing capacity, adjusted retries, and monitored backlog.
What we're offering: 1 week platform credit (2 weeks for high-touch accounts) and a 1:1 office-hours slot if you want guided help. Reply to prioritize imports.
Sorry for the disruption; we'll follow up with a short post-incident summary and a feedback link.

ashley-se: tweak subject to include region tag and add "If urgent, reply and we'll prioritize imports."

maria-cs: Will send individualized notes to 3 high-touch accounts within 45m and a localized bulk message to trials after translations. Posting an update in 30m and a customer-facing RCA within 24h.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created: "EU migration onboarding latency" Severity=S2 Owners=maria-cs,sam-eng,neil-ops
